findings.title: FirstLaunch handoff never publishes the existing Match route
findings.reproduction: Clear app data; choose English and Full guidance; complete FirstLaunch; observe the loading cover indefinitely; cold restart and observe ResumeHandoff with the same cover.
findings.cause: FirstLaunchNarrativeShellCompositionSystemHelper persisted EnterMission/HandoffPending without adding the existing UiShellRouteIntent.EnterMatch request, so the existing Match lifecycle owner never loaded the Match world.
findings.response: Publish exactly one existing EnterMatch/Match route request from the existing handoff boundary, guarded by handoffPublished.
findings.closureEvidence: Samsung replay logged deferred Match scene/gameplay requests and LoadingGate gameplayInitialized=1 playRequested=1 simulationActive=1

findings.title: Production never projects the M01 catalog or correlated logical map
findings.reproduction: Install the first corrected APK; clear app data; choose English and Full guidance; complete FirstLaunch; observe live Match start under an indefinitely retained FL-P18 final presentation.
findings.cause: CampaignMissionCatalogProjection had test-only callers. Production therefore had no campaign mission root/catalog or logical M01 operation-map metadata, so the typed launch could not be accepted after Match loaded.
findings.response: Project the already-authored M01 mission/scenario/Chapter01 map catalog from a bounded Menu runtime and let the existing Match map bootstrap reuse that logical metadata only for exact mission/scenario/map/source correlation while loading the unchanged compatibility physical source.
findings.closureRequires: Fresh exact-source APK build, Samsung install, and successful Full/Contextual/Minimal mission replay
